item.title: Like Aethalides, who passes between the living and the dead, Dormedes #4642 the Twice-Born
item.description: Like Aethalides, who passes between the living and the dead, Dormedes #4642 the Twice-Born rose from Asphodel and returned to the Field of Ares. Dormedes has drunk from Lethe 2 times and remembers little.

item.description: Broken, not dead: Melippos #2392 the Twice-Born (fell in the war of Field of Ares and Lemnos). The Reapers carry the pieces to Asphodel.
